title: β-Caryophyllene in hypoxic UFH-001: an executed FPKM dose audit
question: Which metabolic and signaling responses to terpene exposure are reproducible, and which depend on cellular context or a specific target?

sources.title: GEO GSE125511 series and nine samples

claims.text: GSE125511 contains three DMSO vehicle, three 20 µM β-caryophyllene, and three 200 µM β-caryophyllene UFH-001 bulk RNA-seq libraries, all under 1% oxygen for 16 hours.
claims.limitation: No normoxic treated arm is present, so an oxygen-by-treatment interaction cannot be estimated.

claims.text: The three vehicle libraries are the same libraries deposited as GSM3514416, GSM3514418, and GSM3514420 in GSE123856.
claims.limitation: These controls must not be counted as an independent cohort in a synthesis.

claims.text: The pinned matrix contains 60,603 unique feature rows and nine complete nonnegative FPKM columns. A pinned one-to-one approved HGNC crosswalk maps 40,641 rows; 14,055 mapped rows have mean FPKM at least 1 in an arm.
claims.limitation: Mapping coverage depends on the pinned 2026 HGNC snapshot. FPKM is processed abundance, not raw integer counts.

claims.text: Median pairwise Pearson correlations of log1p(FPKM) are 0.9855 within vehicle, 0.9863 within 20 µM, and 0.9866 within 200 µM libraries.
claims.limitation: Similar global profiles do not establish treatment equivalence or support a differential-expression claim.

claims.text: Among the 14,055 filtered mapped rows, descriptive mean-FPKM ratios with a 0.1 pseudocount place 250 higher and 226 lower by at least twofold at 20 µM, versus 364 higher and 263 lower at 200 µM. With a 1.0 pseudocount the respective counts are 188/184 and 259/194.
claims.limitation: These threshold counts are pseudocount-sensitive descriptions, not statistically tested DEGs. Both contrasts share the same three controls.

claims.text: At 200 µM, mean HMGCR FPKM is 163.36 versus 56.71 in vehicle (descriptive log2 ratio +1.525 with a 0.1 pseudocount); SCD, SQLE, FDFT1, HMGCS1, INSIG1, and STARD4 also show higher mean FPKM. These markers have little mean change at 20 µM.
claims.limitation: Marker directions alone do not establish pathway significance, flux, cholesterol synthesis, or direct HMGCR binding.

claims.text: The source article reports a cholesterol-biosynthesis response and increased β-caryophyllene sensitivity when HMGCR is blocked.
claims.limitation: The notebook does not reproduce the intervention experiment, and the reported interaction does not prove direct ligand binding to HMGCR.

claims.text: PGF mean FPKM is 0.483 in vehicle and 0.333 at 200 µM, below the predeclared FPKM filter; its 0.1-pseudocount log2 ratio is -0.429.
claims.limitation: Low expression and differing cell context, oxygen, dose, time, vehicle, and quantification prevent a PGF replication claim across GSE125511 and GSE276099.

claims.text: Reprocess raw libraries with a pinned reference and replicate-aware count model, then compare cholesterol and signaling effects with the processed-matrix directions.
claims.limitation: Raw-read reprocessing, differential-expression inference, and adjusted p-values were not generated here.

claims.text: Cross UFH-001 and HepG2 cells with matched β-caryophyllene doses, oxygen conditions, vehicle, exposure time, and HMGCR or PGF perturbations to estimate context and target interactions.
claims.limitation: The existing studies confound these design factors and contain no shared genetic Perturb-seq contrast.
